information_flow: The first call receives all common inputs and forms exactly one self-contained executable closure carrying one complete executable policy artifact and its public-obligation justification. The final call consumes only that closure as its sole evidence and control source, exercises final authority within the received state, and emits one policy.
name: Closed-World Terminal Cut
organization: two-call sequential lineage with one complete executable closure followed by a terminal call having no external side inputs

calls.objective: Use the supplied evidence to form exactly one self-contained executable closure carrying one complete executable policy artifact, its current semantic account, and its justification against public obligations.
Consume the preceding complete executable closure as the sole available evidence and control source, adjudicate its internal semantic and contract claims, and emit one complete policy.
